query:
SELECT * 
                    FROM mods m 
                    WHERE 
                        m.name ILIKE $1 OR 
                        EXISTS (
                            SELECT m.* FROM mods mi 
                            INNER JOIN game_mods gm ON 
                                gm.mod_id=mi.id AND gm.game_id=$2 AND 
                                m.id=mi.id
                        )
                    ORDER BY (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM game_mods gmo WHERE gmo.mod_id=m.id) DESC
